title: Virtual visits
summary: Explains what a virtual visit is, how coverage varies by insurance type, and virtual options for mental health and emotional support.

atoms.title: What a virtual visit is
atoms.question: What is a virtual visit?
atoms.text: A virtual visit, also known as telehealth, uses digital technologies like a smartphone, tablet or computer to talk with a health care provider from home or work. During a virtual visit you can get treatment options and even prescriptions for medications, if needed. UnitedHealthcare offers members options for virtual visits with local providers or with its preferred national providers.
questions: Is telehealth the same as a virtual visit?

atoms.title: Are virtual visits covered?
atoms.question: Are virtual visits covered by my health insurance?
atoms.text: Virtual visits may be covered by your health insurance in a similar way to an office visit with your doctor. Depending on your benefits, you may be able to schedule a virtual visit with a local provider or have a virtual visit for primary care, therapy, specialty care or 24/7 care with a national provider for urgent care or when your provider is not available. Sign in or call the number on your member ID card to check.
questions: How do I check virtual visit benefits?

atoms.title: Virtual visit options by insurance type
atoms.question: How do virtual visit options differ by type of insurance?
atoms.text: Members with health insurance through work should talk to a local provider, and many UnitedHealthcare employer plans include 24/7 Virtual Visits, virtual primary care, virtual therapy and virtual specialty care with preferred national providers. Individual and Family ACA Marketplace coverage depends on plan benefits. Medicare Advantage members should ask local providers and sign in to learn about coverage. Medicaid virtual visit coverage may vary by state.
questions: Does Medicare Advantage cover virtual visits?

atoms.title: Types of services available virtually
atoms.question: What kinds of care can be delivered virtually?
atoms.text: Virtual care may include in-network virtual visits for medical, mental health, physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, chiropractic, home health, vision, hearing and dental services. Availability depends on the health plan.
questions: Can I do physical therapy virtually?

atoms.title: Virtual visits for mental health
atoms.question: Can I have a mental health visit virtually?
atoms.text: If you need care for mental health issues, local health care providers may be able to provide virtual visits. Coverage may depend on your health plan benefits, so sign in to your account or call the number on your member ID card to learn what benefits may be available.
questions: Does my plan cover virtual therapy?
How do I get therapy online?

atoms.title: Calm app and Talkspace emotional support
atoms.question: What emotional support apps may be included with my plan?
atoms.text: Some emotional support programs may be included with certain health plans. The Calm Health app offers programs and tools to support mental health and well-being at your own pace, including mindfulness content created by psychologists. Talkspace online therapy lets you communicate with a therapist from your phone or desktop with no office visit required, and eligible members can get started at talkspace.com/connect.
questions: Is Calm Health included in my plan?

atoms.title: Virtual visit or in-person visit?
atoms.question: When should I choose a virtual visit versus seeing a doctor in person?
atoms.text: It is important to know the difference between when to choose a virtual visit and when to see a doctor in person. Virtual visits can be a convenient way to get care or manage prescriptions, but for more serious issues it may be necessary to go to a clinic or hospital.
questions: Should I do telehealth or go in person?

atoms.title: Starting a virtual visit through the UHC app
atoms.question: How do I start a virtual visit?
atoms.text: Members can sign in to their member account or use the UnitedHealthcare app to see their virtual visits benefits and find care. For benefits coverage information, UnitedHealthcare directs members to sign in to their account, since coverage differs by plan.
